title: HeadCalc convergence-criterion causal isolation at G21I split iterations
question: At the B1 iteration-4 and B2 iteration-3 convergence splits, which existing HeadCalc convergence criterion prevents the binary64-adjacent status-6 head from accepting the otherwise backtracking-count-equivalent Newton prefix?
headcalc_semantics: Compartment residual sets nonconvergence when abs(residual_i) > CritDevBalCp.
Head change sets nonconvergence from CritDevh2Cp or CritDevh1Cp depending on old-head magnitude.
Ponding balance may set nonconvergence when the applicable ponding branch exceeds CritDevPondDt.
Total residual sets nonconvergence when abs(sum(residual)) > CritDevBalTot.

CritDevBalCp is additionally used inside backtracking through Fmax < CritDevBalCp; therefore changing it can alter the Newton/backtracking trajectory and is excluded from the primary no-path-change criterion knockout.
Head, total-balance and ponding tolerances are evaluated in the convergence section and do not control the preceding backtracking accept test.
primary_intervention_contract: Use a fresh immutable-origin raw backend solve for every arm, max_retries=0, frozen final-retry duration and frozen max_iterations for that boundary.
Copy corrector_parameters and corrector_config only. Never mutate saved production/test fixture values.
Run baseline status-6 and status-0 arms first and require exact G21I solver status, nonlinear-iteration and cumulative-backtracking reproduction.
At the status-6 head, run all seven non-empty subsets of {HEAD, TOTAL, POND} with only those copied tolerances set to 1e6 while compartment_balance remains exactly 1e-12.

For every primary intervention arm require cumulative backtracking to remain identical to the baseline status-6 split-prefix count. A changed count invalidates direct convergence-criterion interpretation for that arm.
Identify minimal relaxing subsets that switch the physical solver from nonconverged to converged.
secondary_compartment_contract: Only if the union HEAD+TOTAL+POND still does not converge, infer from HeadCalc source semantics that compartment balance remains a necessary blocker among the ordinary non-macropore criteria.
Then run a secondary COMPARTMENT-only and ALL-criteria relaxed arm as support, explicitly recording whether backtracking count changes because CritDevBalCp also participates in backtracking.
A compartment-relaxed convergence result is supportive, not by itself proof of a pure convergence-only effect if backtracking changes.

classification_rules.HEAD_CHANGE_BLOCKER: A minimal primary subset containing HEAD but not TOTAL/POND switches the status-6 head to convergence with unchanged backtracking.
classification_rules.TOTAL_BALANCE_BLOCKER: A minimal primary subset containing TOTAL but not HEAD/POND switches it with unchanged backtracking.
classification_rules.PONDING_BLOCKER: A minimal primary subset containing POND but not HEAD/TOTAL switches it with unchanged backtracking.
classification_rules.MULTIPLE_NONCOMPARTMENT_CRITERIA_REQUIRE: No single primary criterion switches convergence, but a multi-criterion subset does with unchanged backtracking.
classification_rules.COMPARTMENT_BALANCE_NECESSARY_BLOCKER: HEAD+TOTAL+POND relaxed still fails at unchanged backtracking, leaving compartment balance as the necessary active ordinary criterion under the source-audited non-macropore route.
classification_rules.MIXED_OR_UNRESOLVED: Primary interventions change backtracking unexpectedly or source/fixture conditions prevent unique causal classification.

gates: Production HeadCalc source confirms the exact criterion and backtracking roles stated above.
Corrector macropore physics is disabled in the frozen FGC44 fixture, excluding macropore convergence branches.
B1 and B2 baseline adjacent heads reproduce G21I at max_iterations 4 and 3 respectively.
All seven HEAD/TOTAL/POND primary subsets are executed for each status-6 head.
Compartment tolerance remains bitwise equal to 1e-12 in every primary arm.
Primary-arm backtracking count remains equal to the corresponding frozen G21I baseline or the arm is classified path-interfering.
Saved corrector parameters/configuration remain functionally unchanged after all interventions, proven by the normal G16 status vector [6,0,0,6].
Accepted revision/time/ledger and participant/G16 publication authority remain unchanged.
pass_interpretation: PASS qualifies only causal localization of the frozen convergence predicate. Diagnostic tolerance knockout is not a proposed tolerance change and creates no production admission.
fail_interpretation: Preserve ambiguity. Do not change production tolerances, smooth statuses, reinterpret status 6, or broaden participant admissibility to manufacture a single blocker.
